bhatti.p: [Bhaja+ti] (thī) Google Translate သူ စိ. ဘ ဇ နံ ဘတ္ တိ. နိ ရုတ္ တိ၊ Nose. 86. Bhatti = Badeka Jasita Vuttibeda. [1] Adherence, devotion, devotion. (20) Love. (3) Criticism.

B:
bhatti：bhatti（thī）
ဘတ္တိ（ထီ）
[bhaja+ti，sūci．bhajanaṃ bhatti．nirutti，nhā．486．bhatti=bhadekāgracitravuttibhede．thoma．]
[ဘဇ+တိ၊ သူစိ။ ဘဇနံ ဘတ္တိ။ နိရုတ္တိ၊ နှာ။ ၄၈၆။ ဘတ္တိ=ဘဒေကာဂြစိတြဝုတ္တိဘေဒေ။ ထောမ။]
P: Bhatti，（f．） [cp．Vedic & Class．Sk．bhakti，fr．bhaj： see bhajati] 1．devotion，attachment，fondness Pug．20= Dhs．1326 （cp．Dhs．trsl．345）; Pug．65; J．V，340 （=sineha C．）; VI，349; VvA．353，354．-- 2．in bhatti-kata Th．2，413 it means “service，＂ thus “doing service＂ （or “rendered a servant＂？）．-- 3．of uncertain meaning in bhatti-kamma，probably “making lines，decoration，ornamentation＂ Vin．II，113 （°kamma-kata decorated），I．51．The reading is uncertain，may be bhati° （？ Kern，Toev．s．v．trsls “patchwork＂？）．Cp．vi°．（Page 497）
K:
bhatti：ဘတ္တိ（ထီ）
[ဘဇ+တိ၊ သူစိ။ ဘဇနံ ဘတ္တိ။ နိရုတ္တိ၊ နှာ။ ၄၈၆။ ဘတ္တိ=ဘဒေကာဂြစိတြဝုတ္တိဘေဒေ။ ထောမ။]
（၁） မှီဝဲ-ဆည်းကပ်-ခစား-ခြင်း။ （၂ဝ ချစ်ခြင်း။ （၃） ဝေဖန်ခြင်း။ （၄） တဖို့-တစ်ဖက်-၌ ဆန်းကြယ်စွာပြုခြင်း။ ဘတ္တိကမ္မ-ကြည့်။
R:
bhatti：ဘတ္တိ （ဣ） （√ဘဇ်+တိ）
ဆည်းကပ်ခြင်း။ ဝတ်ပြုခြင်း။ ချစ်ခြင်း။ ခွဲဝေခြင်း။
DOP: bhatti f. [ S. bhakti], 1. attachment; affection, fondness; devotion; Abh 1055 (~i sevane); Ja V 340, 3* (~iṃ ca tayi sampassaṃ nāvakaṅkhāmi jīvitaṃ; 342, 1´ : ~in ti sinehaṃ); Dhs 1326 (sevanā nisevanā … ~i sambhatti sampavaṅkatā) = Vibh 359, 27 ; Ps I 11, 16 (vanayatī ti … attasampadāya sattānaṃ ~iṃ karoti attani sinehaṃ uppādetī ti attho, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be kāreti) = Paṭis-a 533, 2 ( eds kāreti) ≠ Ud-a 56, 1 ; Nidd-a I 451, 30 (titthiyasāvakā ti °-vasena tesaṃ paccayadāyakā); Sadd 347, 30 (bhaja sevāyaṃ: bhajati … ~i); — ifc see daḷha-; — 2. a stripe, a line; variegated decoration; — bhattiṃ in Ee at Ja VI 349, 27 is wr for bhattaṃ ( Be, Ce, Se so ); — °- kata , mfn. , acting with devotion; serving loyally; Thī 413 (Thī-a 246, 14 : ~an ti katasāmibhatikaṃ, eds so; better -bhattikaṃ?); Ap 313, 10 (~o sukhumālo, Ee so; Be, Ce vipattivigato; Se vibhattigatto); — °- kamma , bhittikamma, n. , making a striped mark or pattern with figures; Vin II 113, 4 (citrāni pattamaṇḍalāni dhārenti rūpakākiṇṇāni bhittikammakatāni, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee bhatikamma-); 151, 4 (anujānāmi bhikkhave ~an ti, haranti yeva, *anujānāmi bhikkhave hatthabhattikamman ti, haranti yeva,* anujānāmi bhikkhave hatthabhattin ti, Be so; Ce, Ee, Se omit *– *; Ee hatthabhittin ti; Se bhittikamman ti … hatthabhittin ti; Sp 1219, 1 : ~an ti bhisicchaviyā upari ~aṃ, hatthabhattin ti pañcaṅgulibhattiṃ, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se bhittikamman ti bhisīchaviyā upari bhittikammaṃ, hatthabhittin ti pañcaṅgulabhittiṃ; Vmv [ Be ] II 238, 21 : bhittikamman ti nānāvaṇṇehi vibhittirājikaraṇaṃ); Sp 291, 17 (pattamaṇḍale ~aṃ na vaṭṭati, makaradantakaṃ pana vaṭṭati, Ee, Se so; Be, Ce bhittikammaṃ) ≠ Vin-vn 3048 (bhittikammaṃ); — °- ma(t) , mfn. , full of devotion; serving loyally; attached to; Th 370 (°-mā); Nidd-a I 110, 15 (tesu kāmesu °-mā hutvā vasantī ti tappoṇā, Ee, Se so, perhaps wr; Be, Ce sanninnā); — see also daḷhabhattika.

bhattika.p: [Bhatta+ika] (ti) Google Translate (1) who came for alms; . He (Bhikkhu) (2) Invited by alms; Alms-giving He (Daika).

B:
bhattika：bhattika（ti）
ဘတ္တိက（တိ）
[bhatta+ika]
[ဘတ္တ+ဣက]
P: Bhattika，（adj．） （-°） [fr．bhatta] in dhuva° being in constant supply of food，being a regular attendant （servant） or adviser Vin．II，15．Also at ThA．267 in meaning “being a servant，working for food＂ in expln of bhattikatā （=kata-sāmi-bhattikā），said of a toiling housewife．（Page 497）
K:
bhattika：ဘတ္တိက（တိ）
[ဘတ္တ+ဣက]
（၁） ဆွမ်းအကျိုးငှါလာသော၊ ဆွမ်းစားပင့်ထားသော၊ သူ။ （ရဟန်း） （၂） ဆွမ်းဖြင့် ပင့်ဖိတ်သော၊ ဆွမ်းလှူသော၊ သူ။ （ဒါယကာ）။
R:
bhattika：ဘတ္တိက （ပ） （ဘတ္တ+ဣက）
ဆွမ်းစားသော ရဟန်း။
DOP: 1 bhattika m. [bhatta + ika], one taking a meal; Vin III 161, 11 (ye je sve ~ā āgacchanti te … kaṇājakena bilaṅgadutiyena parivisā ti).

P: Bhattimant，（adj．） [from bhatti] 1．devoted？ 2．discerning，analytical，perspicacious？ Th．1，370; Com．has：yathānusiṭṭhaṁ paṭipattiyā tattha bhattimā nāma．（Page 497）
